name: Wilbert L. Gore
bio: American engineer. He left a chemical firm in 1958 and founded W. L. Gore and Associates at Newark, Delaware, the firm that made the Gore-Tex membrane.

milestones.event: Founded his firm at Newark, Delaware.
His son Bob stretched a rod of PTFE and made the porous membrane that the firm later sold in Gore-Tex.
His firm sold the first membrane cloth for garments.
